goal: SnipMD phase 4: saving flows (SPEC §6.1, §6.2, §6.4): autosave, carried text format, external changes and conflicts, the first-save bar with image promotion, Save As with image copy

signatures.signature: pub fn atomic_write(target: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> (unchanged signature)
signatures.doc: snipmd_core::atomic, three fixes from review/phase2-R1.md. D7: when target is a symlink (symlink_metadata), write to the file it points to (fs::canonicalize) so the link stays a link. D8: when the existing target is read-only (metadata().permissions().readonly()), return ErrorKind::PermissionDenied with the message `read-only` and touch nothing. D9: on Windows the temp file is created with FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN (std::os::windows::fs::OpenOptionsExt::attributes(0x2), cfg(windows)); give create_unique an OpenOptions-taking variant or parameter for that, snips stay unhidden. Everything else in R3/R3b unchanged.

signatures.signature: pub fn move_dir(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()>; pub fn copy_dir(from: &Path, to: &Path) -> std::io::Result<()>
signatures.doc: snipmd_core::assets (assets_dir_for already exists). copy_dir: creates `to` with fs::create_dir when missing (its parent must exist; never create_dir_all), copies every file and subfolder of `from` recursively; each file is created with create_new and streamed with io::copy, so an existing file in `to` is an AlreadyExists error and is never overwritten; `from` is untouched. move_dir: when `to` does not exist, fs::rename; when the rename fails (another drive) or `to` already exists, copy_dir then fs::remove_dir_all(from), removing only after the whole copy succeeded (CLAUDE.md guardrail 3). A missing `from` is NotFound. links.rs: delete the rewrite_prefix stub (links are rewritten in the editor, T12).

signatures.signature: pub fn valid_note_name(name: &str) -> bool; impl AllowedSet { pub fn allow_note_folder(&mut self, dir: &Path); pub fn may_create_in(&self, dir: &Path) -> bool }
signatures.doc: snipmd_core::paths. valid_note_name: a plain file name, at most 255 chars, ending in `.md` (case-insensitive) with a non-empty stem; no `/ \\ : * ? " < > |`, no control characters, no trailing dot or space, and a stem that is not a Windows device name (reuse the device check behind valid_tab_id). allow_note_folder: a folder where new notes may be created (normalized like allow_dir, but it does not allow the files inside). may_create_in: true for a folder given to allow_note_folder or the folder of a note given to allow_note; same normalization and case folding as check().

signatures.signature: read_markdown_file(path) -> NoteFile; write_markdown_file(path, content, format: Option<{crlf,bom}>) -> DiskStamp; stat_note(path) -> Option<DiskStamp>; promote_untitled(tab_id, note_path) -> Option<PrefixMove>; copy_assets(from_note, to_note) -> Option<PrefixMove>; default_note_folder() -> String; pick_folder() -> Option<String>; note_name_free(folder, name) -> bool; claim_new_note(folder, name) -> String
signatures.doc: src-tauri/src/lib.rs, every file-system command #[tauri::command(async)], shapes exactly as src/types.ts and src/ipc.ts (camelCase: NoteFile {text, format:{crlf,bom}, stamp:{mtimeMs,size}}, DiskStamp {mtimeMs,size} from metadata().modified() in ms since the epoch and len(), PrefixMove {from,to}). read: decode as today, plus format and stamp. write: the given format, or (None) sniff/NEW_FILE as today; returns the stamp after the rename. stat_note: check_path, NotFound gives None, other errors Err. promote_untitled: ImageHome-style checks (valid_tab_id, check_path); scratch/<tab_id>/ missing or empty gives None; else assets::move_dir into assets_dir_for(note) and Some({from: "untitled.assets/", to: encode_link_path("<stem>.assets/")}). copy_assets: both notes check_path'd; same path or no <from-stem>.assets/ folder gives None; else copy_dir and Some({from: encode("<old stem>.assets/"), to: encode("<new stem>.assets/")}). default_note_folder: app.path().document_dir()/Notes, create_dir_all, allow_note_folder, returned as a string. pick_folder: the dialog plugin's folder picker (same channel pattern as pick), allow_note_folder on the result. note_name_free: valid_note_name and may_create_in(folder) or Err, then whether folder/name does not exist. claim_new_note: the same checks, then OpenOptions create_new of an empty file (AlreadyExists is an error naming the file), allow_note, return the path. load_session: also allow_note_folder(lastFolder) when the session has one; save_session: a lastFolder for which may_create_in is false is set to null (like filePath today). Delete promote_scratch_assets, gc_scratch_assets, resolve_scratchpad_dir, extract_referenced_snips and the regex crate (src-tauri/Cargo.toml), and the gc calls in load_session.

signatures.signature: export function rewriteImagePrefix(tabId: string, move: PrefixMove): number
signatures.doc: src/editor/links.ts. In the tab's state (visible or not; getState + applyToTab), every Markdown Image whose URL text starts with exactly move.from gets that prefix replaced by move.to; links in code, other links and other prefixes stay. All replacements in one transaction (one undo step, so Ctrl+Z after a first save restores the old links), cursor mapped. Uses ensureSyntaxTree(state, state.doc.length, 1000) so a long note that is not visible is fully parsed. Returns the number of links changed.

signatures.signature: export async function saveTab(id: string): Promise<boolean>; export async function saveAs(id: string): Promise<boolean>; export async function flushDirty(): Promise<void>; export function scheduleAutosave(id: string): void
signatures.doc: src/saving.ts. Disk writes as today (one per tab at a time, merged follow-ups, newest text) plus: writeNote(path, text, tab.format) and markSaved(id, {text, stamp}); beginWrite/endWrite around each write; a tab inConflict is never written (saveTab, autosave, flushDirty skip it). scheduleAutosave: 1 s after the last call for that tab, saveTab when it is a dirty disk tab (bound to bindEditListener in app.ts). First save (saveTab of an untitled tab, and saveAs of one): askFirstSave (T14); a {folder,name} choice gives claimNewNote, 'other' gives pickSavePath, null stops; then promoteUntitled(tab.id, target) and rewriteImagePrefix with its move, then writeNote(target, textOf(tab), null), markSaved with the path, setLastFolder(dirname(target)). On any failure the tab stays untitled with its text and its images in scratch, and one showError names the step. saveAs of a disk tab: pickSavePath(title); same path is a plain save; else copyAssets(old, target), rewriteImagePrefix, writeNote(target, text, tab.format), markSaved with the new path; the original note and folder stay untouched.

signatures.signature: export type FirstSaveChoice = { folder: string; name: string } | 'other' | null; export function askFirstSave(tab: TabState, text: string): Promise<FirstSaveChoice>
signatures.doc: src/firstSaveBar.ts, SPEC §6.2. One keyed top info bar (key `firstsave:<tab id>`, kind info, text `Save as`) whose body holds: a folder button showing the folder's last segment followed by ` ›` (click: pickFolder, keeps the old folder on cancel), a name input prefilled from the first Markdown heading of `text` slugified (lowercase, accents removed via NFD, every run of other characters becomes `-`, trimmed, `.md` added; `# DHCP-probleem lokaal B` gives `dhcp-probleem-lokaal-b.md`), fallback `note-YYYYMMDD.md` (local date), a Save button and an `Other folder…` button. Folder: getLastFolder() or else defaultNoteFolder(). While the name is invalid or taken (noteNameFree false or rejecting, checked after each input, latest answer wins) the input has class `taken` and Save is disabled. Enter in the input saves when allowed; Esc or the bar's dismiss resolves null; Other folder… resolves 'other'. The input gets focus and its stem is selected. Resolving clears the bar. Built with DOM APIs (src/dom.ts button), no innerHTML. CSS for the controls goes into src/styles/main.css.

signatures.signature: export function startExternalWatch(): void; export async function checkTabs(): Promise<void>
signatures.doc: src/external.ts, SPEC §6.1 external changes. checkTabs: for every disk tab with a disk stamp that is not isWriting and not inConflict, statNote in parallel (allSettled; a failing stat is ignored). Same stamp: nothing. Changed and the tab clean: readNote, replace only the changed middle of the document (common prefix and suffix kept, so cursor and scroll stay), then markSaved(id, {text, stamp}); the tab's format becomes the read one. Changed and the tab dirty: setConflict(id, true) and a keyed warning bar (key `external:<tab id>`) `<title> was changed outside SnipMD and you have changes too.` with Open disk version (readNote, then openCopy(`<title> (disk)`, text, 'read'); the bar stays), Reload (replace as for a clean tab, setConflict false) and Keep mine (tab.disk = the new stamp, setConflict false, saveTab). Gone (statNote null): the tab turns dirty if it was clean, setConflict(id, true), keyed warning bar `<title> is no longer on disk.` with Save again (setConflict false, saveTab). startExternalWatch: checkTabs on window focus and every 2 s while document.hasFocus(); the interval stops on blur. Never rejects.

phases.title: Build core, external changes and first-save bar

units.task: Implement R3c, R7 and R2b in snipmd-core exactly as the contract documents them: atomic.rs (D7 symlink, D8 read-only, D9 hidden temp on Windows), assets.rs (move_dir, copy_dir; assets_dir_for stays), paths.rs (valid_note_name, AllowedSet::allow_note_folder and may_create_in), links.rs (delete rewrite_prefix). Do not edit core/src/lib.rs. Tests: core/tests/atomic.rs (extend; unix-only cases under cfg(unix)): writing through a symlink keeps the symlink and changes the real file; a read-only target errs with PermissionDenied and keeps its bytes; existing cases stay green. core/tests/assets.rs (extend): copy_dir copies nested files, leaves `from` intact, and errs without changing an existing file of the same name in `to`; copy_dir into a folder whose parent is missing errs and creates nothing; move_dir to a new folder moves everything; move_dir into an existing folder merges and removes `from` only when every file copied; move_dir of a missing `from` is NotFound. core/tests/paths.rs (extend): valid_note_name accepts `a.md`, `Labo 04.MD`, `é.md` and refuses `.md`, `a.txt`, `a/b.md`, `a:b.md`, `con.md`, `a .md`, `a.md.` and 256 chars; may_create_in is true for a folder of an allowed note and an allowed note folder, false for a sibling folder, a subfolder of a note folder and `C:/notes-other` next to `C:/notes`.
units.output: atomic.rs, assets.rs, paths.rs, links.rs changed; tests extended; checks passing.

units.task: Adversarial review of the phase 4 diff (git diff main) against SPEC.md §6.1, §6.2, §6.4 and §8 and the CLAUDE.md guardrails 1-9, 12 and 13 and the code conventions. Hunt for: any path that loses text or images (first save failing halfway, promote failing, Save As failing, a conflict resolved wrongly, a reload over unsaved edits); an overwrite of an existing note or image (claim race, copy_dir, move_dir merge, Save As onto the original's folder); a deletion of anything next to a user's note; the source folder removed before the copy finished; an own write seen as an outside change, or an outside change missed while a write runs; autosave writing a tab in conflict; a format change (CRLF, BOM) on save; links rewritten that do not start with the exact prefix, or not undoable in one step; a Rust command that creates or reads a path outside the allowed set or the may_create_in folders (lastFolder from a tampered session, a name with separators or a device name); the first-save bar built with innerHTML or offering a taken name; anything that breaks phase 0-3 behaviour (paste, drop, session restore, close flush, the allowed-set checks).
